titulo: Xbox CEO calls Project Helix a ‘family of devices’
cuerpo: According to Xbox CEO Asha Sharma, Project Helix, which she announced in March as a codename for Microsoft's "next generation console" - phrasing that seemingly implied a singular device - will actually be a "family" of devices."
